# Local browser dependencies

- Three.js r180 (0.180.0), MIT. Official npm distribution via jsDelivr. `three.core.min.js`, `three.module.min.js`, `OrbitControls.js`; license in `three/LICENSE`. OrbitControls imports are changed to the relative locally vendored module.
- Toolbar SVGs in `neural-worm/research.mjs` follow Lucide's play, pause, rotate-ccw, maximize and image shapes. ISC license, copyright Lucide contributors; license in `lucide-LICENSE`.

These scripts are served locally without a runtime CDN dependency. Media from Vmus is streamed from its original host and is not covered by these software licenses.
